scripts.release:portable: npm run release && npm run release:zip
scripts.release:zip: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$root='release/PDF工具箱-1.0.0-便携版'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $root | Out-Null; Copy-Item src-tauri/target/release/pdf-compress.exe $root; Copy-Item docs/用户手册.md $root; Compress-Archive -Path $root -DestinationPath release/PDF工具箱-1.0.0-便携版.zip -Force; Get-Item release/PDF工具箱-1.0.0-便携版.zip, $root/pdf-compress.exe | Select-Object Name,Length,LastWriteTime"
